answer: A hardware attestation protocol requires agents to submit cryptographic proofs from trusted execution environments before admission. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of scarce physical secure enclaves per identity. Serving as a defensive jetty against an ocean of sybil registrations, the gateway verifies silicon root keys before granting a saffron access ticket. A key limitation is that hardware side-channel flaws can allow attackers to extract keys and spoof authentic devices.
